slides.headline:
ser vs. estar:
the rule spanish class
never explains right 🤔

SER is who you ARE.
permanent. identity.
slides.body:
soy doctora. soy alta.
soy de méxico.

slides.headline:
ESTAR is how you FEEL.
temporary. state.
slides.body:
estoy cansada. estoy
feliz. estoy en casa.

slides.headline:
"soy feliz."
vs.
"estoy feliz."
slides.body:
one means "I'm a happy
person." the other means
"I feel happy right now."

slides.headline:
tip: location ALWAYS
takes estar.
slides.body:
méxico está en
norteamérica — even though
that's permanent!

slides.headline:
the trick: ask yourself —
"is this permanent,
or just right now?"

save this for your next
"ser vs estar" panic 💚

5 mexican spanish words
you won't learn in class 🇲🇽
"ahorita"
slides.body:
technically "right now" —
actually means "eventually,
maybe, who knows." 😅

slides.headline: "qué onda"
slides.body:
what's up? how's it going?
the classic mexican greeting.

slides.headline: "güey"
slides.body:
dude / man — used between
friends, like 50 times
per conversation.
